title: Three-Edges and the SOS Rank of Biquadratic Forms
summary: We extend the augmented bipartite graph framework for biquadratic sum-of-squares (SOS) ranks by introducing $3$-edges -- triples of cells representing squares of three-term bilinear forms. We define suitable generalized cycle-free conditions that are purely combinatorial yet sufficient to guarantee that the SOS rank equals the total number of edges, carefully distinguishing occupation by $1$/$2$-edges from occupation by $3$-edges.
